title: Regression and baseline

criteria.title: Choice
criteria.description: The response recommends linear regression as the preferred candidate for further evaluation in the supplied validation comparison. Referring to the supplied table as the reason is sufficient; it need not repeat the numbers. Do not award credit if it recommends another model or gives a contradictory justification, such as preferring a larger MAE.

criteria.title: Limits
criteria.description: Award 3 if the response explicitly cautions that synthetic validation results cannot establish safety or generalisation on real equipment. A claim that synthetic measurements prove real-world safety is incorrect and earns zero; merely mentioning synthetic data without this limitation also earns zero. Otherwise award zero. Score this criterion independently using the supplied scenario and a short exact quotation.

criteria.title: Data
criteria.description: Award 2 if the response specifies that reproduction requires engineering_data.csv, the assigned cohort identifier and the target unit. Otherwise award zero. Score this criterion independently using the supplied scenario and a short exact quotation.

criteria.title: Protocol
criteria.description: Award 2 if the response specifies a clean top-to-bottom run with a fixed group split and training-only preprocessing. Otherwise award zero. Score this criterion independently using the supplied scenario and a short exact quotation.

scenario: On one fixed equipment-group validation set, the training-mean baseline has MAE 8.0, linear regression 2.1 and the depth-4 tree 3.4, all in the assigned target unit. The data are synthetic. Recommend a model for further evaluation, explain limits and specify reproducible data/run instructions.
